---
title: "How much nose ballast is needed for the required CG?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 150.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 33.1      # s the probe actually used

plane = get_airplane()
total_mass, cg_unballasted = get_mass_properties(plane)

# Inherited from earlier entry
req_cg = 0.267

# Assume ballast at nose
nose_x = plane.fuselages[0].xsecs[0].xyz_c[0]

ballast_mass = total_mass * (cg_unballasted[0] - req_cg) / (req_cg - nose_x)
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{ballast_mass*1000:.1f} g"`]{.hero-value}
[ballast required at the nose]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The unballasted aircraft has a mass of [`{python} f"{total_mass*1000:.1f}"`]{.key} g and its CG rests at [`{python} f"{cg_unballasted[0]:.3f}"`]{.key} m aft of the datum. To bring the balance point forward to the [required CG](2026-09-24-02-where-is-the-neutral-point-and-the-required-cg.qmd), we need [`{python} f"{ballast_mass*1000:.1f}"`]{.key} g of ballast at the nose tip (`x=`[`{python} f"{nose_x:.3f}"`]{.key} m).

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **Mass model: fuse solid, wings sheet**, from volumes.
2. **Ballast location: nose tip**, best for gliders.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
footer(get_mass_properties)
```
